finalText:
It builds clean now, no more errors.

Two real bugs were hiding under all that deprecation noise, both from the bundler bump.

1. `src/core/options.js` still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler renamed that field to `retryCount`. Fixed to read the new name.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` treated a missing backoff flag as invalid and threw. The new config loader leaves unset flags `undefined` instead of `false`, so I made undefined mean "disabled" too.

Build now exits clean: 0 errors, 8 warnings (all genuine deprecation noise from the bump).
